purpose: Curated policy for scholarly identity, persistent identifiers, citation metadata, reproducibility readiness, and long-term preservation. This registry records only verified public facts and does not create identifiers that do not exist.

identity_policy.software_identifier: GitHub canonical URL until a DOI is assigned

research_objects: RO-Crate when a project has a bounded reusable research object

reproducibility_levels.label: Reproducible inputs
reproducibility_levels.criterion: Documentation plus explicit license, citation metadata, and computational environment or tests.

reproducibility_levels.label: Automated
reproducibility_levels.criterion: Level 2 plus continuous integration or an equivalent automated validation workflow.

reproducibility_levels.label: Archived release
reproducibility_levels.criterion: Level 3 plus a versioned release and archival persistent identifier.

reproducibility_levels.label: Research object
reproducibility_levels.criterion: Level 4 plus a bounded, machine-readable research object with provenance.
